goal.summary: 在主线 12 关之后打通全部 14 个精英关（13-26 关）：战役模式、普通难度；最终评测从新存档按解锁顺序打完全部 26 关（同一架构：8B 策略脑 + 小网络操作脑）

native-search.purpose: elite run 1: build-order search (steady-state GA) on all 14 elite stages in action scope v3 (v2 plus barracks rally steps, the boss-blocking order, dormant bosses that no longer hold back wave calls or anchor spells, per-lane path progress for multi-exit maps); fitness = mean over train seeds 1001-1002, profiles at 2.75 stars per earlier level, free heroes; then the 6 best plans per level validated on train seeds 1003-1010; elite run 2: warm start from run 1 (stopped at the owner's request after 1860 games: its 24 best plans per level adopted as measured, same seeds, profile and protocol), new plan gene f (the fallback's build-first factor: after the plan, upgrade a few strong towers before filling every holder), up to 500 new plans per level, then the 8 best validated on train seeds 1003-1010; elite run 3 (after an independent code review and a search diagnosis): journal appends verify only when the file changed (run 2 had slowed from 99 to ~27 games/min re-hashing its whole journal per game), the host serves a client's follow-up requests in the same frame (Windows capped hidden game windows to ~57 frames/s, pacing every request; replays of 41 main and 39 elite games identical), level 18 tunnel routes in path progress, dormant bosses ignored by the fitness, elite-only random immigrants (10%) and a fallback-gene mutation; levels 23 and 25 (already won on both search seeds) left for validation; budget weighted toward the levels that gate others (24 -> 25/26, 18 -> 19) and the near misses, stop after 3 plans win both seeds or 800 evaluations without a new best; warm start from runs 1-2 (best 24 per level; levels 18, 20 and 21 re-played because their measurement changed); the 12 best plans per level validated on train seeds 1003-1010, also after a time-reserve stop; elite run 4: new fallback gene cap (no new tower once 6/8/10/12 standard towers stand, so gold goes to upgrades; the diagnosis found the fallback filling every holder with level-1 towers because only affordable items are offered), level-20 plans restricted to Ignus (the only free hero immune to its burning floors and flares; 39 of 45 games reaching wave 10 used him), levels 18/23/24/25 (already won on both search seeds) left for validation, warm start from runs 1-3 (best 24 per level adopted as measured); elite run 5 (after a probe-game investigation of the stuck stages): every elite game so far was played at 2.75 stars per earlier level (58 stars at level 23), but a real campaign reaches the elites with 31-34 main stars and at most a few per won elite (about 40 at level 23); probes measured plans collapsing with fewer stars. So the search and validation now run at [2.6 per main level, 1.0 per earlier elite], the best 16 plans per level from runs 1-4 are re-played at that profile, levels 20, 21 and 22 (no win; 21/22 behind unsolved stages) are parked, and validation on train seeds 1003-1010 runs in the reserve after a time-reserve stop (it never ran before: a fix); elite run 6: the Heroic challenges (mode 2: 6 waves, 1 life, hero locked) of main levels 1-12, which a player opens by winning the level with 3 stars; each won challenge adds a star to the upgrade budget (the game recommends 50+ stars for the elite stages); seeded with the campaign-v1 final portfolio plans of each level (re-played in this mode, without their hero); profiles: the main campaign at 2.6 stars per level with the challenged level at 3 stars and half of the earlier challenges won; elite run 7: the Iron challenges (mode 3: one long wave, 1 life, hero locked) of main levels 1-12, which a player opens by winning the level with 3 stars; each won challenge adds a star to the upgrade budget (the game recommends 50+ stars for the elite stages); seeded with the campaign-v1 final portfolio plans of each level (re-played in this mode, without their hero); profiles: the main campaign at 2.6 stars per level with the challenged level at 3 stars and half of the earlier challenges won; elite run 8: the option-A star profile (prepared while the owner decides): main levels at 3 stars (replayed for stars after level 12, as a player does to open the challenges) plus 12 Heroic/Iron challenge stars (the validated Heroic portfolio covers about 6-7 challenges; Iron is being searched), 1 star per earlier elite stage: about 58 stars at level 24, where the 2.75-profile plans won 7/8 at 61 stars and 0/8 at 55; the best 16 plans per level from runs 1-5 re-played at this profile; elite run 9: levels 24 (it gates 25, whose option-A portfolio covers 10/10 seeds, and 26), 19 and 26 at a refined option-A estimate [3, 1.2, 13] (main levels at 3 stars after replays, the ~13 challenge stars the validated challenge portfolios cover, and the stars of the ~5 elite stages won before: about 62 stars at level 24); the best 24 plans per level from runs 1-8 re-played at this profile; elite run 10: levels 24, 19, 26 and 17 with 4 search seeds (run 9's plans won both of its 2 search seeds but few of the 8 validation seeds: selection on more seeds favours plans that hold on unseen ones), populations without behavioural twins (an exact repeat of a kept plan's mean fitness), option-A profile [3, 1.2, 13]; the best 16 plans per level from runs 1-9 re-played on the 4 search seeds; elite run 11: levels 24, 13, 26 and 19 searched on train seeds 1005-1008 (runs 9 and 10 searched 1001-1004) and validated on the other six, to widen the retry portfolios of these seed-sensitive levels (level-24 portfolio plans won 3 of 52 games on seeds they were not chosen on) and to retry level 13, whose best plans bring the 18,000-HP boss Sarelgaz to its last 4-30% (403 run-8 games on train seeds reached the final wave 20 without a win); the best 16 plans per level from runs 5, 8, 9 and 10 re-played on the new search seeds; elite run 12: levels 24, 13, 15, 26 and 19 on train seeds 1005-1008 (validated on the other six); run 11 was stopped because its warm start imported nothing (only games on the current search seeds counted), fixed so re-played plans come from any measured train game (the best 24 per level from runs 5, 8, 9, 10, 11); levels 13 and 15 also start from soft-cap twins of their 8 best capped plans (new gene value cap -N: builds resume while 1000+ gold is banked; capped plans reached the last wave with 3,000-6,000 gold unspent and half the holders empty); elite run 13: levels 15 (it unlocks 22), 26 and 24 on train seeds 1001-1004 (run 12 searched 1005-1008 and found the first level-15 wins with the soft tower cap), validated on 1005-1010, to widen the retry portfolios; the best 24 plans per level from runs 5 and 8-12 re-played, plus soft-cap twins of the best capped plans
